# The Resonance Hub

> Reson8.life is the source of truth for the full Resonance ecosystem — every app, update, pricing plan, checkout, and ecosystem package. Individual apps use once-off credits and project packs. Optional monthly ecosystem passes (Creator Pass, Studio Pass, Business Pass) are available from the Hub for creators and teams using multiple tools.

## Purchase model

- **Individual apps: once-off only.** ePublisher, Creative Studio, Sync Vision, and YouTube Optimizer sell once-off credit / project / audit packs. There are no per-app monthly subscriptions.
- **Hub-only ecosystem passes.** Only reson8.life sells recurring subscriptions, and only when they bundle multiple apps: Creator Pass (R499/mo), Studio Pass (R1,499/mo), Business Pass (custom).
- **Free.** The Resonance Podcast is always free. Career Compass is in free pilot; per-report and school packages will follow.
- **Checkout.** All purchases run through the Hub via PayFast in ZAR.

## Pages

- [Home](/): The Resonance Hub — apps, updates, pricing, bundles, roadmap, governance.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Once-off app packs and optional ecosystem passes.
- [Governance](/governance): The Resonance Constitutional Governance Framework (RCGF) v1.0.

## Apps

- [Resonance ePublisher](https://www.resonanceonline.life): Turn topics, manuscripts, PDFs, and research into audiovisual eBooks. Once-off packs from R99.
- [Creative Studio](https://www.creativestudio.life): AI-generated posters, brochures, ads and marketing videos. Once-off packs from R149.
- [Sync Vision](https://www.syncvision.life): AI-ready music video storyboards and character performances. Once-off packs from R349.
- [YouTube Optimizer](https://www.youtubeoptimizer.life): Channel audits, thumbnails, and growth strategy. Once-off packs from R149.
- [Career Compass](https://www.career-compass.org): Career and aptitude discovery for learners and schools. Free pilot.
- [The Resonance Podcast](https://www.resonance-podcast.com): Free ecosystem media and conversations.
